definitions.review_reason: For USEQ-89722999 clause 1, the scanner first fixes the complete minimum evidence record identity set. A pinned lossless schema then reads these exact typed members: evidence record id, reassessment trigger version, reassessment trigger definition. The closed predicate requires exact key coverage and proves that each named field is present for every independently inventoried subject with its declared raw type.
definitions.counterexample_analysis: Missing, malformed, or unversioned trigger definitions fail; the rule does not claim the chosen trigger is optimal. In the executable negative case for USEQ-89722999 clause 1, all unrelated fields stay valid while the input leaves the required reassessment trigger version empty; the predicate must return Fail.
